name: At Home in the Shadows
summary: "At Home in the Shadows" is an introductory rogue quest on Zephras Isle. After aiding Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove, budding rogues are directed to read a summons and meet their local class mentor, Akeri Duskblade. The quest marks the moment young rogues transition from general village chores to serious stealth and combat training.

sections.title: A Shady Invitation
sections.body: While handling basic threats around Thendal Grove, young rogues draw the attention of Akeri Duskblade, the grove's resident rogue trainer. Rather than mingling openly in the settlement, Akeri passes a simple note through Rorian the Dayseeker. Rorian recognizes that despite Akeri's suspicious demeanor, the mentor understands the practical skills needed to survive outside the grove's sheltered boundaries.

sections.title: Lessons in the Watchtower
sections.body: Tucked away inside the village watchtower, Akeri Duskblade wastes no time mincing words. He evaluates every newcomer's footing and awareness immediately upon their arrival, warning that sloppy footwork outside Thendal Grove leads straight to an early grave. By surviving Akeri's scrutiny, a rogue takes their first formal step into mastering stealth, precision, and survival on Zephras Isle.

faq.q: Who gives the quest At Home in the Shadows?
aliases: who starts at home in the shadows
quest giver at home in the shadows
faq.answer: Rorian the Dayseeker offers the quest in Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle after you complete "Harmony in Balance."

faq.q: Where can I find Akeri Duskblade?
faq.answer: Akeri Duskblade is located inside the village watchtower in Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle.

faq.q: What is the Simple Note given during the quest?
faq.answer: The Simple Note is a message left by Akeri Duskblade requesting an audience with promising rogues. You must read it before speaking to Akeri to complete your objective.

faq.q: Is this quest available to all classes?
aliases: can non rogues do this quest
is at home in the shadows rogue only
faq.answer: No, this quest is specifically intended for rogues learning their trade in Thendal Grove.
Akeri Duskblade serves as the local rogue trainer in Thendal Grove, providing instruction in stealth, cunning, and bladecraft for novices beginning their journey across Zephras Isle.

faq.q: What prerequisite quest must be completed first?
aliases: at home in the shadows prerequisite
unlock at home in the shadows
faq.answer: You must first complete "Harmony in Balance" for Rorian the Dayseeker before he hands you Akeri's note.

angles.text: This quest establishes your formal rogue training on Zephras Isle, introducing you to Akeri Duskblade in the Thendal Grove watchtower.
